summary: Card additions from the #10 handoff: `surface="outlined"` (hairline, no shadow), Card.Header `subtitle` (body-sm muted, outside the heading, aria-describedby on the card), Card.Body (a region that scrolls under a bottom Fade when its height is capped — the answer to the footer-divider ask), and `collapsible` / isOpen / onOpenChange (a ghost chevron trigger last in the header actions, named by the title, controlling Card.Body). Card now depends on Button, Fade, motion, use-controllable-state and use-scroll-edges.
